study.question: Does routing the already learned private task history summaries into the shared field/history tokens before JointBlock improve validation macro AUC beyond R12 (0.8310755947860231), both frozen source bests (g0 0.8303789178781177; g3 0.8294837888998853), and an equally sized active mean-summary exchange, at measured justified cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed: R12 improves g0 by 0.0006966769079054 macro AUC, with a small click AUC/Logloss regression; its private/mean and linear/copy factorial favors private+linear in the recorded seed. R13 contextual scorer inputs did not exceed R12, R14 gradient stops lost, and R15 private64/shared210 trunks reached only 0.8309133862899759/0.8309514201872332 at 682.31/651.00 wall seconds versus R12 594.11. These constrain those implementations, not all context integration or task specialization. R14-open exactly repeats R12 at the same recipe/seed and is not an independent replication. Source inspection identifies a different architectural restriction: task summaries enter only the final towers after the shared JointBlock; they cannot affect that interaction. Hypothesis: a small masked read of the four summaries by existing tokens lets the shared interaction use task distinctions that final concatenation alone handles poorly. This restriction is structural evidence, not evidence that it causes the score ceiling. All current performance/mechanism conclusions remain single-seed and no novelty is asserted.

nearest_work.difference: Keep the entire incumbent, but add one one-way summary-to-token cross-attention before the existing JointBlock. Direct private summaries still reach each tower. The mean control changes only the new route, unlike the old R12 mean-routing control which changed direct readouts.

Inherit its collapsed feedback content, separate counts, 20-slot memory and masked token interaction unchanged. Add a distinct four-slot memory sourced from learned task summaries, not another feedback-mask memory.

Inherit the target/action-aware scorer, private content+projected rank summary and direct readout through R12. The new path changes where these summaries can act, without another scorer trunk or wider tower.

study.proposed_difference: Add TaskSummaryExchange after feedback_memory and before JointBlock. Existing tokens query four memory slots built by a shared bias-free 112->32 projection of S_t=global_DIN+C_t+P(M_t), plus learned task identities. Two 16-wide attention heads use FP32 scores/softmax and exact masking/renormalization. Task identities enter both keys and values, so the mean-source control remains an active query-dependent learned function. A bias-free zero-initialized 32->32 output residual preserves the initial incumbent function. All slots are masked iff the authorized history is empty, and invalid query tokens are zeroed. No new tower tokens or dimensions. Candidate uses S_t privately on this route; control uses four copies of mean_t(S_t). Both retain private direct S_t in the towers. Compute the inherited task pool once, earlier in forward; it depends only on target/history, not interaction output. Append construction inside a CPU RNG fork after all inherited initialization. Estimated identical +7936 dense parameters per arm; total33077193, embeddings31793216, dense1283977, subject to host measurement.
predictions: Under the frozen matched recipe, private exchange exceeds both mean exchange and R12 on all-four-task macro AUC; source bests are additional references, not the selection ceiling. Use the existing tie breakers for exact ties and report every task delta without adding veto thresholds.

With paired initialized states and exchange output zero, both variants reproduce R12 predictions, inherited states, Dice buffers and CPU RNG within precision tolerance. This is a required implementation gate, not a measured result.

On a nondegenerate cloned numerical fixture with open output and differing summaries, equal-mean perturbations of individual S_t leave the mean-source exchange unchanged but can change the private exchange. This diagnostic is isolated to the exchange: full direct private tower readouts can change in either model.

For empty histories the exchange update is exactly zero. On nonempty histories, learned identities keep mean-source attention query-dependent when its output is opened. Higher per-task/history-slice gains are exploratory; no slice mechanism claim is predeclared.
falsifiers: Private exchange fails to exceed R12: this implementation has no demonstrated incremental utility even if it beats the mean control.
Mean exchange matches or beats private exchange: added attention/reparameterization or common history information explains the gain as well; task-specific exchange is unsupported.
Any improvement reverses across paired seeds, is smaller than observed seed variation, or does not survive justified measured cost comparison: no repeated mechanism or efficiency support.

Initial replay, mask/target-action invariance, finite FP32/BF16 backward, source-sensitivity witness or active mean-control gate fails: diagnose implementation before interpreting scores. A failed implementation is not a general mechanism refutation.
alternative_explanations: New dense parameters, learned identity values or additional depth/optimization improve performance without using distinct task summaries; mean exchange is the immediate capacity/operator control.

Private versus mean changes effective information and gradient coupling, not nominal parameters alone. End-to-end training can alter embeddings, scorers and shared tokens, so the contrast does not isolate forward information from backward effects.
Additional path changes clipping norms, weight-decay effects and optimization despite identical host hyperparameters; report these where host diagnostics are available.

An early-versus-late location effect is not isolated: no equally sized after-JointBlock arm is scheduled. A positive private-minus-mean contrast supports task specificity at this chosen location, not necessity of that location.
Single-seed model selection and many prior trials cause selection optimism. Repeated same-seed R14-open is replay only. No confidence/significance claim from this screen.

Benchmarked historical delayed actions may be immature at serving time, official vocabularies/filtering use the whole window, and auxiliary labels match user/category/brand rather than advertisement conversions. Conclusions remain offline benchmark-specific.
